capabilities: Track the heading at the current scroll position in real time
Drag the floating window and lock its position
Switch the tracked heading level (H1-H6) via right-click menu
Click the floating heading to scroll to that position
Customize font size, width, colors and Markdown styling of the window
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and notes the plugin has not yet passed Obsidian staff review, so installation currently relies on manual download from Releases; the author also runs a QQ group for support.
problem: While scrolling long documents, it is easy to lose track of which section you are in without opening the outline panel.
summary: Floating-window plugin that shows the current heading based on scroll position in a draggable corner widget.
